assay.biological_context: M2 melanoma cells; HeLa is a comparison system, not the Figure2H/I population. Species was not independently established from the accessed main-text cell labels.
assay.observables: GFP-actin cortical intensity after CK666 and total phalloidin F-actin flow cytometry after nucleator perturbation.
assay.temperature: Not verified in accessed main text; do not infer37°C from human cells.
assay.uncertainty: Figure2H/I error bars SEM; H uses30 cells per experiment. No reported uncertainty for a daughter-filament count fraction.

crosschecks.checked_support: Authors infer comparable F-actin contributions. Figure2H reports about60% cortical-intensity reduction with CK666. Their combined estimate is at least55% of cortical F-actin, assuming flow-cytometry loss is cortical and cortex contributes roughly50% of total cellular fluorescence.
crosschecks.counterevidence_to_overclaim: The paper supports two important nucleators. Its roughly50% cortical share of total fluorescence is not an Arp2/3 daughter-count fraction. Incomplete perturbation and other nucleators remain possible.
crosschecks.recommended_card_action: Retain the quantity-mismatch judgment. Do not present0.5 as disproved; record the additional conversion assumptions and M2-to-target-cell transfer.
unresolved: Filament-length/labeling conversion from fluorescence contribution to number fraction.

crosschecks.checked_support: Exact0.037 is a surface-NPF-normalized rate. The article counts exponentially fading incorporation events and rejects abrupt disappearances.

crosschecks.recommended_card_action: Correct Figure2 to Figure3/page7. Retain the denominator gap and candidate-ineligible2022 DOI. Do not claim the2016 paper cannot contain a related estimate: its fulltext was outside this bounded recheck.
